cases.sentence: О, если бы ты разорвал ________ и сошел, чтобы задрожали бы перед тобой горы!
cases.explain: Разорвал (tore) is a transitive verb requiring the accusative case for its direct object.

cases.sentence: Так огонь зажигает хворост и заставляет бурлить _____.
cases.explain: Заставляет (makes) is a transitive verb requiring the accusative case for its direct object.

cases.sentence: Сойди, чтобы сделать имя свое известным своим ______.
cases.explain: The preposition 'to' (expressing indirect object) after 'known to' requires the dative case.

cases.sentence: С древних времен никто не слышал, никакое ухо не внимало, никакой глаз не видел другого ______, кроме тебя.
cases.explain: The comparative structure 'another ... besides you' requires the genitive case after the verb видел (saw) with the preposition 'no' implied.

cases.sentence: Но мы согрешили, и ты прогневался. Долго мы держались за свои _____.
cases.explain: The verb 'держались' (held onto) takes за (for/onto) with the accusative case for plural objects.

cases.sentence: Все мы вянем, как лист, и грехи наши точно _______ уносят нас прочь.
cases.explain: The noun is the grammatical subject of the verb уносят (take away), requiring the nominative case.

cases.sentence: Поэтому Ты скрыл от нас свое _______ и отдал нас в руки наших грехов.
cases.explain: The verb скрыл (hid) is transitive and requires the accusative case for its direct object.

cases.sentence: Мы глина, а Ты наш _______. Все мы — дело Твоих рук.
cases.explain: After the linking verb 'Ты' (you are), the predicate nominative горшечник requires the nominative case.

reading.ru: О, если бы ты разорвал небеса и сошел, чтобы задрожали бы перед тобой горы!
reading.question: What does the speaker wish God would do?
options: Tear the heavens and come down so the mountains would quake
Build a new temple in Jerusalem
Reveal all the secrets of the nations
Bring rain to the dry lands
reading.correct: Tear the heavens and come down so the mountains would quake
reading.explain: The text says 'О, если бы ты разорвал небеса и сошел, чтобы задрожали бы перед тобой горы!' — 'Oh, that you would tear the heavens and come down, that the mountains might quake!'

reading.ru: С древних времен никто не слышал, никакое ухо не внимало, никакой глаз не видел другого Бога, кроме тебя, действующего для тех, кто его ждет.
reading.question: What does this verse emphasize about God?
options: No one has ever heard, seen, or perceived any God like you who acts for those who wait for him
All gods are the same and have no special powers
God never appeared to ancient people
Only the wealthy and powerful can worship God
reading.correct: No one has ever heard, seen, or perceived any God like you who acts for those who wait for him
reading.explain: The passage emphasizes that throughout history, no ear has heard, no eye has seen a God like the one who acts for those who wait for him.

reading.ru: Все мы стали как нечистый, все наши праведные дела как запачканная одежда.
reading.question: How does the speaker describe the people's righteous deeds and their spiritual state?
options: All their righteous deeds are like polluted garments, and they have become unclean
Their deeds are spotless and pristine before God
They are blessed and pure in God's eyes
They surpass all other nations in virtue
reading.correct: All their righteous deeds are like polluted garments, and they have become unclean
reading.explain: The text says 'Все мы стали как нечистый, все наши праведные дела как запачканная одежда' — all have become unclean, and all their righteous deeds are like a filthy garment.

reading.ru: Мы глина, а Ты наш горшачник. Все мы — дело Твоих рук.
reading.question: What metaphor does the speaker use to describe the relationship between God and his people?
options: God is the potter and the people are the clay; the people are the work of his hands
God is the judge and the people are his servants
God is the king and the people are his soldiers
God is the father and the people are his children
reading.correct: God is the potter and the people are the clay; the people are the work of his hands
reading.explain: The verse uses the metaphor: 'Мы глина, а Ты наш горшачник' — 'We are the clay, and you are our potter.'

reading.ru: Поэтому Ты скрыл от нас свое лицо и отдал нас в руки наших грехов.
reading.question: What consequences result from the people's sin?
options: God has hidden his face and delivered them into the power of their sins
God has promised to bless them abundantly
God has made them rulers of great nations
God has protected them from all enemies
reading.correct: God has hidden his face and delivered them into the power of their sins
reading.explain: The text states 'Ты скрыл от нас свое лицо и отдал нас в руки наших грехов' — you have hidden your face from us and delivered us into the hands of our sins.

reading.ru: Наш святой и славный храм, где наши предки возносили тебе хвалу, сожжен огнем, и все, чем мы дорожили, лежит в развалинах.
reading.question: What has happened to the holy temple and the people's valued possessions?
options: The temple has been burned with fire and all their precious things lie in ruins
The temple has been beautifully restored and renovated
The temple is filled with treasures and wealth
The temple has expanded to hold more worshippers
reading.correct: The temple has been burned with fire and all their precious things lie in ruins
reading.explain: The passage says the holy and glorious temple where ancestors praised God 'сожжен огнем' — has been burned with fire, and all they cherished lies in ruins.
